log.notes: The translation was a free rewrite. Restored all original content: definitions of planar graphs and faces, the facts section (Euler's theorem, edge and face bounds, minimum degree), the next-edge and outer-face subsections, complexity, the disconnected-graph discussion with its image, the segments-to-graph section with its image, and both original code blocks. Removed the added shoelace formula, the invented area function and the invented traversal code.
Rewrote the whole article in Uzbek following the original and the glossary (tugun, qirra, daraja, kesma, vektor/qutb burchagi, xesh jadvali).
Both code blocks restored to the original; the n - m + f = 1 + k formula restored and the invented display formulas removed.
